title: A278992：从已知指数生成函数严格推出四阶 D-finite 递推
confidence_basis: The proof, exact certificate, fail-closed verifier, independent symbolic check, boundary analysis, and exhaustive small-case audit all pass. After temporarily withdrawing the release state, an absolute-path manifest verification passed on a stable 33-file staging root containing no logs; the live research log remains preserved outside that root.
summary: PROVED: the stated recurrence follows rigorously from the published EGF for n >= 4 with the canonical a_0 = 0 extension (equivalently n >= 5 at OEIS offset 1). The release manifest is frozen from a stable staging tree that excludes live logs and passes independent absolute-path verification.
